newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Canada sets reverse repurchases at 2.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Canada sets reverse repurchases at 2.75 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada set reverse repurchase agreements at 2.75 percent in the Canadian money market on Thursday to bolster a sagging overnight rate, traders said.
They said the central bank added money to the money market system this morning, leaving most interbank players without bids or an appetite for cash financing.
"There were no bids," one trader said.

Despite the intervention, no bids for overnight financing had been tendered in late afternoon trading, so it was considered to be below the Bank of Canada's target range of 2.75 percent to 3.25 percent.
